entities.summary: The Bung Karno Sports Complex, better known as Gelora Bung Karno; formerly named the Asian Games Complex and the Senayan Sports Complex from 1969 to 2001, is a sports complex located in Gelora, Central Jakarta, bordering the Senayan, South Jakarta because of its large location. This sports complex consists of a main stadium, secondary stadium, two main indoor gymnasiums known as the Sports Palace (Istora) and the Indonesia Arena, football fields, aquatic stadium, tennis stadiums, hockey, baseball and archery fields, and other gymnasiums.
